author: reek
body: Probe (closed by the punctual FIX campaign): three holes, all shut. CDX6004 is now an any-effect-row judgment - a punctual signature must be effect-free, so the custom Tick effect is rejected (its handler's latency is unbounded from the caller's seat). The lambda walk now descends into act statements, so the closure inside draws CDX6003. The call walk has an act arm, so the call to a non-punctual recursive function inside the block draws CDX6001.
